svg.text: Error of the release fraction against the time step on a fixed fine mesh; the dotted line is the spatial error of that mesh, the level the curve approaches
Absolute error of the release fraction at 100 h (dimensionless)
BTCS error against the analytical series
Reference slope of order 1 (grey, dashed), drawn through the finest point
Spatial error of the fixed mesh (from the spatial study)
Verification case: all five regions share the diffusion coefficient 4.316e-14 m²/s, the outer radius is 394.2 µm, the kernel radius 175.0 µm, the end time 100 h, so
the dimensionless Fourier number D t / R² of the whole sphere, with R the outer radius, is 0.1; the reference is the exact series of a sphere with the same diffusivity
everywhere. It is a numerical verification case, not physical data. The orders printed are observed between neighbouring levels; they are reported, not required to meet a
target (decision 7). Solver: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit c9978f0f64b04fe18f312c82c38592f36d05d2f8. The case is a
numerical verification case on the registered AGR1-B-M16 radii with the same synthetic diffusion coefficient in all five regions, kernel-only start, absorbing outer
surface; the reference is the exact series of a homogeneous sphere. It uses no AGR-1 diffusion coefficient and no measurement, and it is not an experimental validation.
